meta.base: OffTranscribe website main@e75e04c and native ProductDesign.swift working tree
meta.note: New website foundations. Brand #0f5c52 matches the native light accent (0.06, 0.36, 0.32); other palette and scale values are deliberate new design decisions, not a full extraction of the legacy purple website.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Quiet page canvas and document sidebars; pair with ink or muted.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Reading surfaces and inverse text on brand or deep.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary copy on paper, canvas or mint.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary readable copy on paper or canvas; never reduced opacity.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Native app light accent, primary buttons, links and focus rings on light surfaces.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Illustrative workspace surround, selection and format strip; use ink text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative separators only; not a sufficient control boundary or text color.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Privacy section and button hover; use paper headings and on-deep body text.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Readable secondary text and dividers on deep.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Pre-release status on paper or canvas, always accompanied by a written status.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Short homepage headline; shrink on mobile and for long locale text.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Main section headings; no forced Latin tracking on Arabic or Indic text.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Introductory text with bounded reading width.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Navigation, notices and footer; do not lower contrast.

styles.name: metadata
styles.usage: Numbered steps, time codes, format labels. Isolate LTR codes in RTL pages.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Fine icon alignment.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon and label gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact control spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile inset and paragraph rhythm.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Reading panel padding and stacked blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop panel padding and column gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section content separation.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Desktop section rhythm; reduce on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, focus rings and language items.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Transcript paper and contact panel.

tokens.name: radius-stage
tokens.usage: Large illustrative workspace surround.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Only for the transcript specimen and floating language menu; never under prose sections.
